name: What is the typical commission structure with a flexible listing agreement?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical commission structure with a flexible listing agreement?

acceptedAnswer.text: With a flexible listing, the commission structure is often more conditional. If the seller finds the buyer independently, no commission is usually owed to the agent. If an agent brings a successful buyer, then the agreed-upon commission is paid. It's crucial to clarify these terms upfront to avoid disputes. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution ensures that all commission terms, including the circumstances under which a commission is earned, are transparently outlined in any agreement, helping you understand your financial commitments from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commission is typically owed only if an agent brings a buyer; if the seller finds the buyer, no commission is paid to the agent.
